chapter: Williams on guitarists, family and touring
title: Williams leaves tapes and gives lessons to white fans
summary: Williams says many white people like the blues; he left tapes and gave lessons in Oakland.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Becoming a teacher: jazz in schools and conservatories

blocks.x: Well, I have met a lot of white folks that really likes the blues. There's a lot of them that I left tapes up there with when I was in Oakland, California. And when I left them overseas, a couple of the white folks, one, well, I left them some tapes. They blew. I said, you want to learn this shit? I said, yes, sit down and take your time. I got to play too fast and I play slow and you learn these blues. And they took them. I give music lessons over there in Oakland. White man that I was staying with, well, he just let me have went on. And he was chatting and it was down, no, two and a half.
